    37	## Two-factor codes
    38	
    39	Sites that ask for a code after the password are handled the same way:
    40	
    41	- **Authenticator key saved with the login** (the "setup key" or `otpauth://`
    42	  link a site shows when you enable 2FA; 1Password and Bitwarden items that
    43	  hold a TOTP seed count too): Hermes generates the current code and enters
    44	  it. Nobody is asked. Add the key in **Settings → Passwords & Logins → Add**
    45	  or `hermes vault add`; the item shows a *2FA auto* badge.
    46	- **Code sent to your phone or email**: a small prompt appears in your
    47	  surface ("Verification code for github.com"), you type the code, Hermes
    48	  enters it into the page. The code never enters the conversation either.
    49	- **Passkeys, hardware keys, app approvals** ("tap Approve in Duo"): nothing
    50	  to type. The agent tells you to complete it on your device and waits for
    51	  the page to move on.

    53	## Already using 1Password or Bitwarden?
    54	
    55	Nothing to enable. If the `op` or `bw` command-line tool is installed and signed
    56	in, Hermes picks it up automatically and its website logins become fillable
    57	alongside the local ones. The first time the agent needs one of those logins it
    58	asks you to unlock the manager with your master password (masked prompt; once
    59	per session, 30 minutes idle). Hermes hands the master password to the manager's
    60	CLI through its non-interactive channel (`op signin` on stdin, `bw unlock
    61	--passwordenv` in the child's environment) and keeps only the session token in
    62	memory. The agent never sees the master password, the token, or any login.
    63	A manager item that lists several websites (say `amazon.co.uk`,
    64	`www.amazon.co.uk` and `eu.account.amazon.com`) fills on each of those exact
    65	origins; nothing is inferred beyond the URLs saved on the item.
    66	
    67	Prefer not to use a detected manager? `hermes vault sources --disable bitwarden`,
    68	or the switch in **Settings → Passwords & Logins**.
    69

    71	
    72	Cards and addresses work the same way as logins: saved once (**Settings →
    73	Passwords & Logins → Add**, or `hermes vault add`), bound to the checkout site,
    74	and filled by the agent on that site only. **Every card fill asks you first**,
    75	with the same approval prompt as a dangerous command; declining writes nothing.
    76	Headless sessions (cron, webhooks, the API server) cannot confirm and are
    77	refused, so a prompt injection that reaches a checkout page can ask, but it
    78	cannot spend. Address fills need no confirmation.
    79

    83	  password managers with Unlock/Lock, Add, Remove.

    85	  `hermes vault sources`.

    88	`0600`), scoped to the profile. Labels, site origins and login identifiers are
    89	visible metadata; passwords and card values never leave the vault except into
    90	the page.
    91	
    92	## Headless sessions
    93	
    94	Cron jobs, webhooks, the API server and `hermes chat -q` have nobody to answer a
    95	prompt. Saved local logins keep working there; a locked password manager reports
    96	`unavailable_in_this_session` and a missing login reports `prompt_unavailable`.
    97	Unlock or save from an interactive session first, or give 1Password a service
    98	account token (`OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN`).

   101	vault:
   102	  onepassword:
   103	    enabled: false          # opt OUT of a detected manager (default: on when installed)
   104	    account: ""             # `op --account` shorthand; empty = default
   105	    service_account_token_env: OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
   106	  bitwarden:
   107	    enabled: false
   108	```

   111	
   112	**Does:** the password never enters the model's context through Hermes: not in
   113	tool results, logs, the session database, or the CLI arguments of any process.
   114	Fills happen over the supervised browser session's direct CDP socket and are
   115	refused unless the page origin exactly matches the saved origin, checked again
   116	inside the page immediately before the write.

   119	site, that site (and any script it runs) has it, exactly as when you type it
   120	yourself. On a cloud browser backend the vendor's browser sees the page like any
   121	other. The origin binding is the guard against filling on the wrong site, not
   122	against a compromised right one.

     6	# Passwords & Logins
     7	
     8	Say **"log into GitHub"** and the agent signs in for you. The first time it

    21	   The agent reached a sign-in page with no saved login for this site.

    32	From then on the agent lists your saved logins, types the identifier itself and
    33	fills the password through Hermes. The tool result it sees is

    35	registered with the redactor so a later page read cannot echo it back.
    36	
    37	## Two-factor codes
    38	
    39	Sites that ask for a code after the password are handled the same way:
    40	
    41	- **Authenticator key saved with the login** (the "setup key" or `otpauth://`
    42	  link a site shows when you enable 2FA; 1Password and Bitwarden items that
    43	  hold a TOTP seed count too): Hermes generates the current code and enters
    44	  it. Nobody is asked. Add the key in **Settings → Passwords & Logins → Add**
    45	  or `hermes vault add`; the item shows a *2FA auto* badge.
    46	- **Code sent to your phone or email**: a small prompt appears in your
    47	  surface ("Verification code for github.com"), you type the code, Hermes
    48	  enters it into the page. The code never enters the conversation either.
    49	- **Passkeys, hardware keys, app approvals** ("tap Approve in Duo"): nothing
    50	  to type. The agent tells you to complete it on your device and waits for
    51	  the page to move on.
    52	
    53	## Already using 1Password or Bitwarden?
    54	
    55	Nothing to enable. If the `op` or `bw` command-line tool is installed and signed
    56	in, Hermes picks it up automatically and its website logins become fillable
    57	alongside the local ones. The first time the agent needs one of those logins it
    58	asks you to unlock the manager with your master password (masked prompt; once
    59	per session, 30 minutes idle). Hermes hands the master password to the manager's
    60	CLI through its non-interactive channel (`op signin` on stdin, `bw unlock
    61	--passwordenv` in the child's environment) and keeps only the session token in
    62	memory. The agent never sees the master password, the token, or any login.
    63	A manager item that lists several websites (say `amazon.co.uk`,

1	"""Local encrypted vault for browser autofill secrets.
     2	
     3	Profile-scoped, model-blind credential store. Metadata (kind, label, origin,
     4	timestamps) lives alongside an encrypted secret payload; the payload is
     5	encrypted at rest with a locally generated Fernet key. The model only ever
     6	sees opaque handles + metadata — secret values are resolved server-side by
     7	the browser fill path and never enter tool results, logs, or the session DB.
     8	
     9	Design notes:
    10	- Follows the repo's "default frictionless, 0600 files OK" policy: the key
    11	  file and vault file are created 0600 under ``<HERMES_HOME>/vault/``.
    12	- Ported design (opaque-handle vault fill) from Merit-Systems/OpenInstinct
    13	  (MIT): lib/manager/server/secret-store.ts + vault services.
    14	- Three item kinds: ``login`` (password-only secret), ``payment`` (card fields) and
    15	  ``address``; ``PAYMENT_FIELDS`` / ``ADDRESS_FIELDS`` are the canonical payload names.
    16	"""
    17	
    18	from __future__ import annotations
    19	
    20	import json
    21	import os
    22	import re
    23	import threading
    24	import uuid
    25	from contextlib import contextmanager, suppress
    26	from dataclasses import dataclass
    27	from datetime import datetime, timezone
    28	from pathlib import Path
    29	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

   220	def browser_vault_list() -> str:
   221	    """List login handles + metadata across every enabled backend. Passwords are never included.
   222	
   223	    A locked external manager contributes no items; instead it is reported under ``locked`` so the
   224	    agent knows to call browser_vault_fill (which prompts the user to unlock) or tell the user.
   225	    """
   226	    from agent.vault_backends import enabled_backends
   227	    from agent.vault_backends.unlock import can_prompt_here
   228	
   229	    items, locked, errors = [], [], []
   230	    for backend in enabled_backends():
   231	        if backend.needs_unlock and not backend.is_unlocked():
   232	            locked.append({"backend": backend.name, "display_name": backend.display_name,
   233	                           "unlock": "browser_vault_unlock" if can_prompt_here() else "unavailable_in_this_session"})
   234	            continue
   235	        try:
   236	            metas = backend.list_items()
   237	        except Exception as exc:
   238	            errors.append({"backend": backend.name, "error": str(exc)[:200]})
   239	            continue
   240	        for meta in metas:
   241	            entry = {"handle": meta.id, "backend": backend.name, "label": meta.label, "kind": meta.kind,
   242	                     "origin": meta.origin, "available": meta.kind == "login" or bool(meta.origin)}
   243	            if len(meta.allowed_origins) > 1:
   244	                entry["allowed_origins"] = list(meta.allowed_origins)
   245	            if meta.has_otp or backend.needs_unlock:
   246	                entry["two_factor"] = "automatic" if meta.has_otp else "automatic if the manager stores a TOTP seed, else the user is asked"
   247	            if meta.identifier:
   248	                entry["identifier"] = meta.identifier
   249	                entry["identifier_type"] = meta.identifier_type
   250	            items.append(entry)
   251	    out: Dict[str, Any] = {"success": True, "items": items}
   252	    if not items:
   253	        out["hint"] = ("No saved logins. On a login page, call browser_vault_save_login to ask the user to save one. "
   254	                       "Never type a password yourself or ask for one in chat, even if it is shown on the page.")
   255	    if locked:
   256	        out["locked"] = locked
   257	    if errors:
   258	        out["errors"] = errors
   259	    return json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False)

   262	def browser_vault_unlock(backend_name: str) -> str:
   263	    """Ask the user (via the surface's masked prompt) to unlock an external manager for this session."""
   264	    from agent.vault_backends import enabled_backends
   265	    from agent.vault_backends.unlock import can_prompt_here, get_unlock_prompt_callback
   266	
   267	    backend = next((b for b in enabled_backends() if b.name == backend_name and b.needs_unlock), None)
   268	    if backend is None:
   269	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": f"No unlockable vault backend named {backend_name!r}."})
   270	    if backend.is_unlocked():
   271	        return json.dumps({"success": True, "backend": backend.name, "already_unlocked": True})
   272	    if not can_prompt_here():
   273	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_unavailable",
   274	                           "error": (f"{backend.display_name} is locked and this session cannot prompt for the "
   275	                                     "master password (headless/cron/API). Unlock it from an interactive Hermes "
   276	                                     "session or the Desktop app first.")})
   277	    prompt = get_unlock_prompt_callback()
   278	    master = prompt(backend.name, backend.display_name) if prompt else ""
   279	    if not master:
   280	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_cancelled",
   281	                           "error": f"The user declined to unlock {backend.display_name}."})
   282	    try:
   283	        backend.unlock(master)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
   284	    except Exception as exc:
   285	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_failed", "error": str(exc)[:300]})
   286	    finally:
   287	        del master
   288	    return json.dumps({"success": True, "backend": backend.name})

   291	def browser_vault_save_login(label: str = "", task_id: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
   292	    """Ask the user (masked prompt on their surface) for the login of the CURRENT page, store it in the local
   293	    vault bound to that origin, and fill the password at once. The values never enter the conversation."""
   294	    from agent.vault_backends.unlock import can_prompt_here, get_save_login_prompt_callback
   295	    from agent.vault_store import get_vault_store
   296	
   297	    effective_task_id = task_id or "default"
   298	    # The supervisor's default page session is whatever tab it attached to first (on Browser Use that is
   299	    # the daemon's blank tab); the login form lives in the tab with a password field, so focus that one.
   300	    _focus_bound_origin(effective_task_id, "", "login")
   301	    origin = _current_page_origin(effective_task_id)
   302	    if not origin:
   303	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Open the site's login page first; the login is saved for that page's origin."})
   304	    prompt = get_save_login_prompt_callback()
   305	    if prompt is None or not can_prompt_here():
   306	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "prompt_unavailable",
   307	                           "error": (f"This session cannot ask the user for a login (headless/cron/API). Tell them to run "
   308	                                     f"`hermes vault add` or use Desktop → Settings → Passwords & Logins for {origin}.")})
   309	    host = origin.split("://", 1)[-1]
   310	    site = label.strip() or host
   311	    answer = prompt(origin, host)  # the prompt names the site by host: the user recognises URLs, not agent labels
   312	    if not answer or not answer.get("password") or not answer.get("identifier"):
   313	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "save_declined",
   314	                           "error": "The user chose not to save a login for this site. Do not ask again this turn."})
   315	    identifier = str(answer["identifier"]).strip()
   316	    id_type = "email" if "@" in identifier else ("phone" if identifier.lstrip("+").isdigit() else "username")
   317	    try:
   318	        meta = get_vault_store().add_item("login", site, {"identifier_type": id_type, "identifier": identifier,
   319	                                                        "password": str(answer["password"])}, origin=origin)
   320	    except Exception as exc:
   321	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "save_failed", "error": str(exc)[:200]})
   322	    finally:
   323	        answer.clear()
   324	    filled = json.loads(browser_vault_fill(meta.id, task_id=effective_task_id))
   325	    return json.dumps({"success": True, "handle": meta.id, "origin": origin, "identifier": identifier,
   326	                       "identifier_type": id_type, "fill": filled,
   327	                       "next": "Type the identifier into the username field if the form has one, then submit."},
   328	                      ensure_ascii=False)

   400	def browser_vault_fill(handle: str, task_id: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
   401	    """Fill the current page's password field from a vault handle.
   402	
   403	    Password-only: the identifier is agent-visible metadata (see
   404	    browser_vault_list) and is typed by the agent via normal input tools.
   405	    The password is resolved server-side and injected via in-page JS over
   406	    the supervisor CDP WebSocket; the result reports only counts/metadata.
   407	    """
   408	    from agent.redact import register_vault_redaction_value
   409	    from agent.vault_login_classifier import (
   410	        ClassifiedLoginControl,
   411	        LoginControl,
   412	        build_fill_js,
   413	        build_inspection_js,
   414	        classify_checkout_control,
   415	        classify_login_control,
   416	        select_checkout_fills,
   417	        select_password_fill,
   418	    )
   419	    from agent.vault_backends import UnlockRequired, backend_for_handle
   420	    from agent.vault_store import ADDRESS_FIELDS, PAYMENT_FIELDS, scrub_secret_from_text
   421	
   422	    effective_task_id = task_id or "default"
   423	    backend = backend_for_handle(handle)
   424	    if backend is not None and backend.needs_unlock and not backend.is_unlocked():
   425	        unlocked = json.loads(browser_vault_unlock(backend.name))
   426	        if not unlocked.get("success"):
   427	            return json.dumps(unlocked)
   428	
   429	    try:
   430	        meta = backend.get_meta(handle) if backend is not None else None
   431	    except UnlockRequired:
   432	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_required",
   433	                           "error": f"{backend.display_name} locked again; call browser_vault_unlock."})
   434	    if meta is None:
   435	        return json.dumps(
   436	            {
   437	                "success": False,
   438	                "error": (
   439	                    f"No vault item with handle {handle!r}. Use browser_vault_list. "
   440	                    "To save a credential: run `hermes vault add` in a terminal, or "
   441	                    "in the desktop app open Settings → Credential Vault."
   442	                ),
   443	            }
   444	        )
   445	    if meta.kind != "login" and not meta.origin:
   446	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "no_origin",
   447	                           "error": f"Vault item {handle!r} has no bound origin; {meta.kind} items are filled only on the site they were saved for."})
   448	    if meta.kind == "payment" and not _confirm_payment_fill(meta.label, str(meta.origin)):
   449	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "payment_declined",
   450	                           "error": "The user did not confirm filling this payment card. Do not retry; ask them instead."})
   451	
   452	    # ── Origin binding pre-check (cheap early exit; the authoritative check
   453	    # runs synchronously inside the fill script itself) ──────────────────────
   454	    # Manager items can bind several websites (e.g. amazon.co.uk + www.amazon.co.uk);
   455	    # every saved origin is a valid fill target. Matching stays exact-origin —
   456	    # nothing wildcard/parent-domain is ever inferred.
   457	    allowed = list(meta.allowed_origins) or ([str(meta.origin)] if meta.origin else [])
   458	    page_origin = None
   459	    for candidate in allowed:
   460	        page_origin = _focus_bound_origin(effective_task_id, candidate, meta.kind)
   461	        if page_origin:
   462	            break
   463	    page_origin = page_origin or _current_page_origin(effective_task_id)
   464	    if not page_origin:
   465	        return json.dumps(
   466	            {"success": False, "error": "Could not determine the current page origin. Navigate to the login page first."}
   467	        )
   468	    if page_origin not in allowed:
   469	        return json.dumps(
   470	            {
   471	                "success": False,
   472	                "error_type": "origin_mismatch",
   473	                "error": (
   474	                    f"Refused: current page origin ({page_origin}) does not match "
   475	                    f"the vault item's bound origin(s) ({', '.join(allowed)}). Vault fills "
   476	                    "only run on the exact origin(s) the credential was saved for."
   477	                ),
   478	            }
   479	        )
   480	
   481	    # ── Inspect + classify page controls ────────────────────────────────────
   482	    nonce = secrets.token_hex(8)  # binds this fill to THIS inspection's stamps
   483	    inspect = _eval_js(effective_task_id, build_inspection_js(nonce))
   484	    if not inspect.get("success"):
   485	        return json.dumps(
   486	            {"success": False, "error": f"Could not inspect page inputs: {inspect.get('error', 'eval failed')}"}
   487	        )
   488	    raw_controls = _parse_json_result(inspect.get("result"))
   489	    if isinstance(raw_controls, str):
   490	        raw_controls = _parse_json_result(raw_controls)
   491	    if not isinstance(raw_controls, list):
   492	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Page input inspection returned no usable controls."})
   493	
   494	    classify = classify_login_control if meta.kind == "login" else classify_checkout_control
   495	    classified: list[ClassifiedLoginControl] = []
   496	    for raw in raw_controls:
   497	        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
   498	            continue
   499	        result = classify(LoginControl.from_dict(raw))
   500	        if result is not None:
   501	            classified.append(result)
   502	    if not classified:
   503	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": f"No {meta.kind} form fields were found on the current page."})
   504	
   505	    # ── Resolve secret and fill (secret never enters any logged string) ─────
   506	    try:
   507	        if meta.kind == "login":
   508	            secret = {"password": backend.resolve_password(handle)}
   509	            fills = select_password_fill(classified, secret["password"])
   510	        else:
   511	            secret = backend.resolve_secret(handle)
   512	            fills = select_checkout_fills(classified, secret, PAYMENT_FIELDS if meta.kind == "payment" else ADDRESS_FIELDS)
   513	    except UnlockRequired:
   514	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_required",
   515	                           "error": f"{backend.display_name} locked again; call browser_vault_unlock."})
   516	    if not fills:

   522	    # BEFORE they touch the page: any later browser_* result (including
   523	    # browser_cdp Runtime.evaluate reads) that echoes them is scrubbed.

   530	            effective_task_id, build_fill_js(fills, expected_origin=page_origin, nonce=nonce)
   531	        )
   532	    except Exception as exc:

   536	        )

   539	        out = {"success": False, "error": err}

   220	def browser_vault_list() -> str:
   221	    """List login handles + metadata across every enabled backend. Passwords are never included.
   222	
   223	    A locked external manager contributes no items; instead it is reported under ``locked`` so the
   224	    agent knows to call browser_vault_fill (which prompts the user to unlock) or tell the user.
   225	    """
   226	    from agent.vault_backends import enabled_backends
   227	    from agent.vault_backends.unlock import can_prompt_here
   228	
   229	    items, locked, errors = [], [], []
   230	    for backend in enabled_backends():
   231	        if backend.needs_unlock and not backend.is_unlocked():
   232	            locked.append({"backend": backend.name, "display_name": backend.display_name,
   233	                           "unlock": "browser_vault_unlock" if can_prompt_here() else "unavailable_in_this_session"})
   234	            continue
   235	        try:
   236	            metas = backend.list_items()
   237	        except Exception as exc:
   238	            errors.append({"backend": backend.name, "error": str(exc)[:200]})
   239	            continue
   240	        for meta in metas:
   241	            entry = {"handle": meta.id, "backend": backend.name, "label": meta.label, "kind": meta.kind,
   242	                     "origin": meta.origin, "available": meta.kind == "login" or bool(meta.origin)}
   243	            if len(meta.allowed_origins) > 1:
   244	                entry["allowed_origins"] = list(meta.allowed_origins)
   245	            if meta.has_otp or backend.needs_unlock:
   246	                entry["two_factor"] = "automatic" if meta.has_otp else "automatic if the manager stores a TOTP seed, else the user is asked"
   247	            if meta.identifier:
   248	                entry["identifier"] = meta.identifier
   249	                entry["identifier_type"] = meta.identifier_type
   250	            items.append(entry)
   251	    out: Dict[str, Any] = {"success": True, "items": items}
   252	    if not items:
   253	        out["hint"] = ("No saved logins. On a login page, call browser_vault_save_login to ask the user to save one. "
   254	                       "Never type a password yourself or ask for one in chat, even if it is shown on the page.")
   255	    if locked:
   256	        out["locked"] = locked
   257	    if errors:
   258	        out["errors"] = errors
   259	    return json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False)

   262	def browser_vault_unlock(backend_name: str) -> str:
   263	    """Ask the user (via the surface's masked prompt) to unlock an external manager for this session."""
   264	    from agent.vault_backends import enabled_backends
   265	    from agent.vault_backends.unlock import can_prompt_here, get_unlock_prompt_callback
   266	
   267	    backend = next((b for b in enabled_backends() if b.name == backend_name and b.needs_unlock), None)
   268	    if backend is None:
   269	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": f"No unlockable vault backend named {backend_name!r}."})
   270	    if backend.is_unlocked():
   271	        return json.dumps({"success": True, "backend": backend.name, "already_unlocked": True})
   272	    if not can_prompt_here():
   273	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_unavailable",
   274	                           "error": (f"{backend.display_name} is locked and this session cannot prompt for the "
   275	                                     "master password (headless/cron/API). Unlock it from an interactive Hermes "
   276	                                     "session or the Desktop app first.")})
   277	    prompt = get_unlock_prompt_callback()
   278	    master = prompt(backend.name, backend.display_name) if prompt else ""
   279	    if not master:
   280	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_cancelled",
   281	                           "error": f"The user declined to unlock {backend.display_name}."})
   282	    try:
   283	        backend.unlock(master)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
   284	    except Exception as exc:
   285	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_failed", "error": str(exc)[:300]})
   286	    finally:
   287	        del master
   288	    return json.dumps({"success": True, "backend": backend.name})

   291	def browser_vault_save_login(label: str = "", task_id: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
   292	    """Ask the user (masked prompt on their surface) for the login of the CURRENT page, store it in the local
   293	    vault bound to that origin, and fill the password at once. The values never enter the conversation."""
   294	    from agent.vault_backends.unlock import can_prompt_here, get_save_login_prompt_callback
   295	    from agent.vault_store import get_vault_store
   296	
   297	    effective_task_id = task_id or "default"
   298	    # The supervisor's default page session is whatever tab it attached to first (on Browser Use that is
   299	    # the daemon's blank tab); the login form lives in the tab with a password field, so focus that one.
   300	    _focus_bound_origin(effective_task_id, "", "login")
   301	    origin = _current_page_origin(effective_task_id)
   302	    if not origin:
   303	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Open the site's login page first; the login is saved for that page's origin."})
   304	    prompt = get_save_login_prompt_callback()
   305	    if prompt is None or not can_prompt_here():
   306	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "prompt_unavailable",
   307	                           "error": (f"This session cannot ask the user for a login (headless/cron/API). Tell them to run "
   308	                                     f"`hermes vault add` or use Desktop → Settings → Passwords & Logins for {origin}.")})
   309	    host = origin.split("://", 1)[-1]
   310	    site = label.strip() or host
   311	    answer = prompt(origin, host)  # the prompt names the site by host: the user recognises URLs, not agent labels
   312	    if not answer or not answer.get("password") or not answer.get("identifier"):
   313	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "save_declined",
   314	                           "error": "The user chose not to save a login for this site. Do not ask again this turn."})
   315	    identifier = str(answer["identifier"]).strip()
   316	    id_type = "email" if "@" in identifier else ("phone" if identifier.lstrip("+").isdigit() else "username")
   317	    try:
   318	        meta = get_vault_store().add_item("login", site, {"identifier_type": id_type, "identifier": identifier,
   319	                                                        "password": str(answer["password"])}, origin=origin)
   320	    except Exception as exc:
   321	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "save_failed", "error": str(exc)[:200]})
   322	    finally:
   323	        answer.clear()
   324	    filled = json.loads(browser_vault_fill(meta.id, task_id=effective_task_id))
   325	    return json.dumps({"success": True, "handle": meta.id, "origin": origin, "identifier": identifier,
   326	                       "identifier_type": id_type, "fill": filled,
   327	                       "next": "Type the identifier into the username field if the form has one, then submit."},

   400	def browser_vault_fill(handle: str, task_id: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
   401	    """Fill the current page's password field from a vault handle.
   402	
   403	    Password-only: the identifier is agent-visible metadata (see
   404	    browser_vault_list) and is typed by the agent via normal input tools.
   405	    The password is resolved server-side and injected via in-page JS over
   406	    the supervisor CDP WebSocket; the result reports only counts/metadata.
   407	    """
   408	    from agent.redact import register_vault_redaction_value
   409	    from agent.vault_login_classifier import (
   410	        ClassifiedLoginControl,
   411	        LoginControl,
   412	        build_fill_js,
   413	        build_inspection_js,
   414	        classify_checkout_control,
   415	        classify_login_control,
   416	        select_checkout_fills,
   417	        select_password_fill,
   418	    )
   419	    from agent.vault_backends import UnlockRequired, backend_for_handle
   420	    from agent.vault_store import ADDRESS_FIELDS, PAYMENT_FIELDS, scrub_secret_from_text
   421	
   422	    effective_task_id = task_id or "default"
   423	    backend = backend_for_handle(handle)
   424	    if backend is not None and backend.needs_unlock and not backend.is_unlocked():
   425	        unlocked = json.loads(browser_vault_unlock(backend.name))
   426	        if not unlocked.get("success"):
   427	            return json.dumps(unlocked)
   428	
   429	    try:
   430	        meta = backend.get_meta(handle) if backend is not None else None
   431	    except UnlockRequired:
   432	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_required",
   433	                           "error": f"{backend.display_name} locked again; call browser_vault_unlock."})
   434	    if meta is None:
   435	        return json.dumps(
   436	            {
   437	                "success": False,
   438	                "error": (
   439	                    f"No vault item with handle {handle!r}. Use browser_vault_list. "
   440	                    "To save a credential: run `hermes vault add` in a terminal, or "
   441	                    "in the desktop app open Settings → Credential Vault."
   442	                ),
   443	            }
   444	        )
   445	    if meta.kind != "login" and not meta.origin:
   446	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "no_origin",
   447	                           "error": f"Vault item {handle!r} has no bound origin; {meta.kind} items are filled only on the site they were saved for."})
   448	    if meta.kind == "payment" and not _confirm_payment_fill(meta.label, str(meta.origin)):
   449	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "payment_declined",
   450	                           "error": "The user did not confirm filling this payment card. Do not retry; ask them instead."})
   451	
   452	    # ── Origin binding pre-check (cheap early exit; the authoritative check
   453	    # runs synchronously inside the fill script itself) ──────────────────────
   454	    # Manager items can bind several websites (e.g. amazon.co.uk + www.amazon.co.uk);
   455	    # every saved origin is a valid fill target. Matching stays exact-origin —
   456	    # nothing wildcard/parent-domain is ever inferred.
   457	    allowed = list(meta.allowed_origins) or ([str(meta.origin)] if meta.origin else [])
   458	    page_origin = None
   459	    for candidate in allowed:
   460	        page_origin = _focus_bound_origin(effective_task_id, candidate, meta.kind)
   461	        if page_origin:
   462	            break
   463	    page_origin = page_origin or _current_page_origin(effective_task_id)
   464	    if not page_origin:
   465	        return json.dumps(
   466	            {"success": False, "error": "Could not determine the current page origin. Navigate to the login page first."}
   467	        )
   468	    if page_origin not in allowed:
   469	        return json.dumps(
   470	            {
   471	                "success": False,
   472	                "error_type": "origin_mismatch",
   473	                "error": (
   474	                    f"Refused: current page origin ({page_origin}) does not match "
   475	                    f"the vault item's bound origin(s) ({', '.join(allowed)}). Vault fills "
   476	                    "only run on the exact origin(s) the credential was saved for."
   477	                ),
   478	            }
   479	        )

   481	    # ── Inspect + classify page controls ────────────────────────────────────
   482	    nonce = secrets.token_hex(8)  # binds this fill to THIS inspection's stamps
   483	    inspect = _eval_js(effective_task_id, build_inspection_js(nonce))
   484	    if not inspect.get("success"):
   485	        return json.dumps(
   486	            {"success": False, "error": f"Could not inspect page inputs: {inspect.get('error', 'eval failed')}"}
   487	        )
   488	    raw_controls = _parse_json_result(inspect.get("result"))
   489	    if isinstance(raw_controls, str):
   490	        raw_controls = _parse_json_result(raw_controls)
   491	    if not isinstance(raw_controls, list):
   492	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Page input inspection returned no usable controls."})
   493	
   494	    classify = classify_login_control if meta.kind == "login" else classify_checkout_control
   495	    classified: list[ClassifiedLoginControl] = []
   496	    for raw in raw_controls:
   497	        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
   498	            continue
   499	        result = classify(LoginControl.from_dict(raw))
   500	        if result is not None:
   501	            classified.append(result)
   502	    if not classified:
   503	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": f"No {meta.kind} form fields were found on the current page."})
   504	
   505	    # ── Resolve secret and fill (secret never enters any logged string) ─────
   506	    try:
   507	        if meta.kind == "login":
   508	            secret = {"password": backend.resolve_password(handle)}
   509	            fills = select_password_fill(classified, secret["password"])
   510	        else:
   511	            secret = backend.resolve_secret(handle)
   512	            fills = select_checkout_fills(classified, secret, PAYMENT_FIELDS if meta.kind == "payment" else ADDRESS_FIELDS)
   513	    except UnlockRequired:
   514	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_required",
   515	                           "error": f"{backend.display_name} locked again; call browser_vault_unlock."})
   516	    if not fills:

   519	        )
   520	
   521	    # Register the secret bytes with the model-egress redaction boundary
   522	    # BEFORE they touch the page: any later browser_* result (including
   523	    # browser_cdp Runtime.evaluate reads) that echoes them is scrubbed.

   528	    try:
   529	        fill_result = _eval_js_secret(

   531	        )
   532	    except Exception as exc:

   534	        return json.dumps(

   536	        )
   537	    if not fill_result.get("success"):

   539	        out = {"success": False, "error": err}

   220	def browser_vault_list() -> str:
   221	    """List login handles + metadata across every enabled backend. Passwords are never included.
   222	
   223	    A locked external manager contributes no items; instead it is reported under ``locked`` so the
   224	    agent knows to call browser_vault_fill (which prompts the user to unlock) or tell the user.
   225	    """
   226	    from agent.vault_backends import enabled_backends
   227	    from agent.vault_backends.unlock import can_prompt_here
   228	
   229	    items, locked, errors = [], [], []
   230	    for backend in enabled_backends():
   231	        if backend.needs_unlock and not backend.is_unlocked():
   232	            locked.append({"backend": backend.name, "display_name": backend.display_name,
   233	                           "unlock": "browser_vault_unlock" if can_prompt_here() else "unavailable_in_this_session"})
   234	            continue
   235	        try:
   236	            metas = backend.list_items()
   237	        except Exception as exc:
   238	            errors.append({"backend": backend.name, "error": str(exc)[:200]})
   239	            continue
   240	        for meta in metas:
   241	            entry = {"handle": meta.id, "backend": backend.name, "label": meta.label, "kind": meta.kind,
   242	                     "origin": meta.origin, "available": meta.kind == "login" or bool(meta.origin)}
   243	            if len(meta.allowed_origins) > 1:
   244	                entry["allowed_origins"] = list(meta.allowed_origins)
   245	            if meta.has_otp or backend.needs_unlock:
   246	                entry["two_factor"] = "automatic" if meta.has_otp else "automatic if the manager stores a TOTP seed, else the user is asked"
   247	            if meta.identifier:
   248	                entry["identifier"] = meta.identifier
   249	                entry["identifier_type"] = meta.identifier_type
   250	            items.append(entry)
   251	    out: Dict[str, Any] = {"success": True, "items": items}
   252	    if not items:
   253	        out["hint"] = ("No saved logins. On a login page, call browser_vault_save_login to ask the user to save one. "
   254	                       "Never type a password yourself or ask for one in chat, even if it is shown on the page.")
   255	    if locked:
   256	        out["locked"] = locked
   257	    if errors:
   258	        out["errors"] = errors
   259	    return json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False)

   262	def browser_vault_unlock(backend_name: str) -> str:
   263	    """Ask the user (via the surface's masked prompt) to unlock an external manager for this session."""
   264	    from agent.vault_backends import enabled_backends
   265	    from agent.vault_backends.unlock import can_prompt_here, get_unlock_prompt_callback
   266	
   267	    backend = next((b for b in enabled_backends() if b.name == backend_name and b.needs_unlock), None)
   268	    if backend is None:
   269	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": f"No unlockable vault backend named {backend_name!r}."})
   270	    if backend.is_unlocked():
   271	        return json.dumps({"success": True, "backend": backend.name, "already_unlocked": True})
   272	    if not can_prompt_here():
   273	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_unavailable",
   274	                           "error": (f"{backend.display_name} is locked and this session cannot prompt for the "
   275	                                     "master password (headless/cron/API). Unlock it from an interactive Hermes "
   276	                                     "session or the Desktop app first.")})
   277	    prompt = get_unlock_prompt_callback()
   278	    master = prompt(backend.name, backend.display_name) if prompt else ""
   279	    if not master:
   280	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_cancelled",
   281	                           "error": f"The user declined to unlock {backend.display_name}."})
   282	    try:
   283	        backend.unlock(master)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
   284	    except Exception as exc:
   285	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_failed", "error": str(exc)[:300]})
   286	    finally:
   287	        del master
   288	    return json.dumps({"success": True, "backend": backend.name})

   291	def browser_vault_save_login(label: str = "", task_id: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
   292	    """Ask the user (masked prompt on their surface) for the login of the CURRENT page, store it in the local
   293	    vault bound to that origin, and fill the password at once. The values never enter the conversation."""
   294	    from agent.vault_backends.unlock import can_prompt_here, get_save_login_prompt_callback
   295	    from agent.vault_store import get_vault_store
   296	
   297	    effective_task_id = task_id or "default"
   298	    # The supervisor's default page session is whatever tab it attached to first (on Browser Use that is
   299	    # the daemon's blank tab); the login form lives in the tab with a password field, so focus that one.
   300	    _focus_bound_origin(effective_task_id, "", "login")
   301	    origin = _current_page_origin(effective_task_id)
   302	    if not origin:
   303	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Open the site's login page first; the login is saved for that page's origin."})
   304	    prompt = get_save_login_prompt_callback()
   305	    if prompt is None or not can_prompt_here():
   306	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "prompt_unavailable",
   307	                           "error": (f"This session cannot ask the user for a login (headless/cron/API). Tell them to run "
   308	                                     f"`hermes vault add` or use Desktop → Settings → Passwords & Logins for {origin}.")})
   309	    host = origin.split("://", 1)[-1]
   310	    site = label.strip() or host
   311	    answer = prompt(origin, host)  # the prompt names the site by host: the user recognises URLs, not agent labels
   312	    if not answer or not answer.get("password") or not answer.get("identifier"):
   313	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "save_declined",
   314	                           "error": "The user chose not to save a login for this site. Do not ask again this turn."})
   315	    identifier = str(answer["identifier"]).strip()
   316	    id_type = "email" if "@" in identifier else ("phone" if identifier.lstrip("+").isdigit() else "username")
   317	    try:
   318	        meta = get_vault_store().add_item("login", site, {"identifier_type": id_type, "identifier": identifier,
   319	                                                        "password": str(answer["password"])}, origin=origin)
   320	    except Exception as exc:
   321	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "save_failed", "error": str(exc)[:200]})
   322	    finally:
   323	        answer.clear()
   324	    filled = json.loads(browser_vault_fill(meta.id, task_id=effective_task_id))
   325	    return json.dumps({"success": True, "handle": meta.id, "origin": origin, "identifier": identifier,
   326	                       "identifier_type": id_type, "fill": filled,
   327	                       "next": "Type the identifier into the username field if the form has one, then submit."},
   328	                      ensure_ascii=False)

   400	def browser_vault_fill(handle: str, task_id: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
   401	    """Fill the current page's password field from a vault handle.
   402	
   403	    Password-only: the identifier is agent-visible metadata (see
   404	    browser_vault_list) and is typed by the agent via normal input tools.
   405	    The password is resolved server-side and injected via in-page JS over
   406	    the supervisor CDP WebSocket; the result reports only counts/metadata.
   407	    """
   408	    from agent.redact import register_vault_redaction_value
   409	    from agent.vault_login_classifier import (
   410	        ClassifiedLoginControl,
   411	        LoginControl,
   412	        build_fill_js,
   413	        build_inspection_js,
   414	        classify_checkout_control,
   415	        classify_login_control,
   416	        select_checkout_fills,
   417	        select_password_fill,
   418	    )
   419	    from agent.vault_backends import UnlockRequired, backend_for_handle
   420	    from agent.vault_store import ADDRESS_FIELDS, PAYMENT_FIELDS, scrub_secret_from_text
   421	
   422	    effective_task_id = task_id or "default"
   423	    backend = backend_for_handle(handle)
   424	    if backend is not None and backend.needs_unlock and not backend.is_unlocked():
   425	        unlocked = json.loads(browser_vault_unlock(backend.name))
   426	        if not unlocked.get("success"):
   427	            return json.dumps(unlocked)
   428	
   429	    try:
   430	        meta = backend.get_meta(handle) if backend is not None else None
   431	    except UnlockRequired:
   432	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_required",
   433	                           "error": f"{backend.display_name} locked again; call browser_vault_unlock."})
   434	    if meta is None:
   435	        return json.dumps(
   436	            {
   437	                "success": False,
   438	                "error": (
   439	                    f"No vault item with handle {handle!r}. Use browser_vault_list. "
   440	                    "To save a credential: run `hermes vault add` in a terminal, or "
   441	                    "in the desktop app open Settings → Credential Vault."
   442	                ),
   443	            }
   444	        )
   445	    if meta.kind != "login" and not meta.origin:
   446	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "no_origin",
   447	                           "error": f"Vault item {handle!r} has no bound origin; {meta.kind} items are filled only on the site they were saved for."})
   448	    if meta.kind == "payment" and not _confirm_payment_fill(meta.label, str(meta.origin)):
   449	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "payment_declined",
   450	                           "error": "The user did not confirm filling this payment card. Do not retry; ask them instead."})
   451	
   452	    # ── Origin binding pre-check (cheap early exit; the authoritative check
   453	    # runs synchronously inside the fill script itself) ──────────────────────
   454	    # Manager items can bind several websites (e.g. amazon.co.uk + www.amazon.co.uk);
   455	    # every saved origin is a valid fill target. Matching stays exact-origin —
   456	    # nothing wildcard/parent-domain is ever inferred.
   457	    allowed = list(meta.allowed_origins) or ([str(meta.origin)] if meta.origin else [])
   458	    page_origin = None
   459	    for candidate in allowed:
   460	        page_origin = _focus_bound_origin(effective_task_id, candidate, meta.kind)
   461	        if page_origin:
   462	            break
   463	    page_origin = page_origin or _current_page_origin(effective_task_id)
   464	    if not page_origin:
   465	        return json.dumps(
   466	            {"success": False, "error": "Could not determine the current page origin. Navigate to the login page first."}
   467	        )
   468	    if page_origin not in allowed:
   469	        return json.dumps(
   470	            {
   471	                "success": False,
   472	                "error_type": "origin_mismatch",
   473	                "error": (
   474	                    f"Refused: current page origin ({page_origin}) does not match "
   475	                    f"the vault item's bound origin(s) ({', '.join(allowed)}). Vault fills "
   476	                    "only run on the exact origin(s) the credential was saved for."
   477	                ),
   478	            }
   479	        )
   480	
   481	    # ── Inspect + classify page controls ────────────────────────────────────
   482	    nonce = secrets.token_hex(8)  # binds this fill to THIS inspection's stamps
   483	    inspect = _eval_js(effective_task_id, build_inspection_js(nonce))
   484	    if not inspect.get("success"):
   485	        return json.dumps(
   486	            {"success": False, "error": f"Could not inspect page inputs: {inspect.get('error', 'eval failed')}"}
   487	        )
   488	    raw_controls = _parse_json_result(inspect.get("result"))
   489	    if isinstance(raw_controls, str):
   490	        raw_controls = _parse_json_result(raw_controls)
   491	    if not isinstance(raw_controls, list):
   492	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": "Page input inspection returned no usable controls."})
   493	
   494	    classify = classify_login_control if meta.kind == "login" else classify_checkout_control
   495	    classified: list[ClassifiedLoginControl] = []
   496	    for raw in raw_controls:
   497	        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
   498	            continue
   499	        result = classify(LoginControl.from_dict(raw))
   500	        if result is not None:
   501	            classified.append(result)
   502	    if not classified:
   503	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error": f"No {meta.kind} form fields were found on the current page."})
   504	
   505	    # ── Resolve secret and fill (secret never enters any logged string) ─────
   506	    try:
   507	        if meta.kind == "login":
   508	            secret = {"password": backend.resolve_password(handle)}
   509	            fills = select_password_fill(classified, secret["password"])
   510	        else:
   511	            secret = backend.resolve_secret(handle)
   512	            fills = select_checkout_fills(classified, secret, PAYMENT_FIELDS if meta.kind == "payment" else ADDRESS_FIELDS)
   513	    except UnlockRequired:
   514	        return json.dumps({"success": False, "error_type": "unlock_required",
   515	                           "error": f"{backend.display_name} locked again; call browser_vault_unlock."})
   516	    if not fills:
   517	        return json.dumps(
   518	            {"success": False, "error": f"No fillable {meta.kind} field matched the saved item on this page."}
   519	        )
   520	
   521	    # Register the secret bytes with the model-egress redaction boundary
   522	    # BEFORE they touch the page: any later browser_* result (including
   523	    # browser_cdp Runtime.evaluate reads) that echoes them is scrubbed.
   524	    # Address values are not secrets but the card fields are: register every payment value.
   525	    for value in (secret.values() if meta.kind == "payment" else [secret.get("password", "")]):
   526	        register_vault_redaction_value(value)
   527	
   528	    try:
   529	        fill_result = _eval_js_secret(
   530	            effective_task_id, build_fill_js(fills, expected_origin=page_origin, nonce=nonce)
   531	        )
   532	    except Exception as exc:
   533	        # Strip any secret material from exception text before surfacing.
   534	        return json.dumps(
   535	            {"success": False, "error": scrub_secret_from_text(str(exc), secret)}
   536	        )
   537	    if not fill_result.get("success"):
   538	        err = scrub_secret_from_text(str(fill_result.get("error") or "fill failed"), secret)
   539	        out = {"success": False, "error": err}
   540	        if fill_result.get("error_type"):
   541	            out["error_type"] = fill_result["error_type"]
   542	        return json.dumps(out)
   543	
   544	    parsed = _parse_json_result(fill_result.get("result"))
   545	    if isinstance(parsed, str):
   546	        parsed = _parse_json_result(parsed)
   547	    if isinstance(parsed, dict) and parsed.get("refused") == "origin_changed":
   548	        return json.dumps(
   549	            {
   550	                "success": False,
   560	    filled = parsed.get("filled", 0) if isinstance(parsed, dict) else 0
   561	
   562	    out = {"success": bool(filled), "filled_fields": int(filled), "backend": backend.name,
   563	           "kind": meta.kind, "origin": page_origin}
   564	    if meta.kind == "login":
   565	        out["next"] = ("Submit. If the site then asks for a verification code, call browser_vault_enter_code with this handle"
   566	                       + (" (a code will be generated automatically)." if meta.has_otp else "."))
   567	    if meta.kind != "login":
   568	        out["fields"] = sorted(f["token"] for f in fills)  # which controls were targeted, never the values
   569	    return json.dumps(out)

1	"""Per-process unlock state for external password managers.
     2	
     3	An unlock is a session token minted by the manager's CLI from the master
     4	password (``op signin --raw`` / ``bw unlock --raw``). The token lives in
     5	process memory only, keyed by backend, and expires after an idle TTL or an
     6	explicit lock. The master password itself is consumed by the CLI call and
     7	dropped; nothing is written to disk or env.
     8	
     9	The surface owns the prompt: ``set_unlock_prompt_callback`` is installed by
    10	the CLI panel / TUI gateway bridge for the current thread, exactly like the
    11	sudo-password callback. Headless contexts (cron, webhook, api_server,
    12	single-query) install none and the vault stays locked — the same posture
    13	approvals take where nobody can answer.
    14	"""
    15	
    16	from __future__ import annotations
    17	
    18	import threading
    19	import time
    20	from typing import Callable, Dict, Optional

    22	_IDLE_TTL_S = 30 * 60
    23

    25	_sessions: Dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[str, float]] = {}   # (profile home, backend) → (token, last_used)

   164	    from tools.approval_context import (

   166	        _is_single_query_approval_context,

   170	        return False

1	"""Login-backend contract + registry for the browser credential vault.
     2	
     3	A ``LoginBackend`` lists login metadata (never secrets) and resolves ONE
     4	password at fill time. External managers (1Password, Bitwarden) additionally
     5	need a per-session unlock; ``resolve_password`` raises ``UnlockRequired``
     6	while locked so the tool can ask the surface to prompt. Handles are
     7	namespaced by ``prefix`` so ``backend_for_handle`` needs no lookup table.
     8	"""
     9	
    10	from __future__ import annotations
    11	
    12	import subprocess
    13	from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
    14	from pathlib import Path
    15	from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Sequence
    16	
    17	from agent.vault_store import VaultItemMeta
    18	
    19	
    20	class UnlockRequired(Exception):
    21	    """The backend is locked for this session; the surface must prompt for the master password."""
    22	
    23	    def __init__(self, backend: "LoginBackend"):
    24	        super().__init__(f"{backend.display_name} is locked")
    25	        self.backend = backend
    26	
    27	
    28	class LoginBackend(ABC):
    29	    name: str                # config key: local | onepassword | bitwarden
    30	    display_name: str        # user-facing
    31	    prefix: str              # handle prefix ("vault_", "op:", "bw:")
    32	    needs_unlock: bool = False
    33	
    34	    def owns(self, handle: str) -> bool:
    35	        return handle.startswith(self.prefix)
    36	
    37	    def is_unlocked(self) -> bool:
    38	        return True
    39	
    40	    @abstractmethod
    41	    def list_items(self) -> List[VaultItemMeta]:
    42	        """Metadata only. Locked external backends return [] (the agent sees a lock hint instead)."""
    43	
    44	    @abstractmethod
    45	    def get_meta(self, handle: str) -> Optional[VaultItemMeta]: ...
    46	
    47	    @abstractmethod
    48	    def resolve_password(self, handle: str) -> str:
    49	        """Server-side only; raises ``UnlockRequired`` when locked."""
    50	
    51	    def resolve_otp(self, handle: str) -> Optional[str]:
    52	        """Current one-time code for a login that stores a TOTP seed, else None (the user is asked).
    53	        Server-side only, like resolve_password."""
    54	        return None
    55	
    56	    def resolve_secret(self, handle: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
    57	        """Full payload of a payment/address item (server-side only). External managers list only
    58	        logins, so the base returns the password-only shape."""
    59	        return {"password": self.resolve_password(handle)}
    60	
    61	
    62	def run_with_stdin_secret(argv: Sequence[str], *, env: Dict[str, str], secret: str, timeout: float,
    63	                          label: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    64	    """Run a manager CLI feeding *secret* on stdin (never argv, never env). Spawn/timeout → RuntimeError."""
    65	    try:
    66	        return subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 — argv list, no shell
    67	            list(argv), env=env, input=secret + "\n", capture_output=True, text=True,
    68	            encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=timeout)
    69	    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
    70	        raise RuntimeError(f"{label} unlock timed out after {timeout:.0f}s") from exc
    71	    except OSError as exc:
    72	        raise RuntimeError(f"failed to invoke {label}: {exc}") from exc
    73	
    74	
    75	def run_with_secret_env(argv: Sequence[str], *, env: Dict[str, str], secret_env: str, secret: str, timeout: float,
    76	                        label: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    77	    """Run a manager CLI whose non-interactive contract reads the secret from a named env var.
    78	    The variable is set on the child's environment only (never argv, never our process)."""
    79	    child_env = dict(env)
    80	    child_env[secret_env] = secret
    81	    try:
    82	        return subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 — argv list, no shell
    83	            list(argv), env=child_env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True,
    84	            encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=timeout)
    85	    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
    86	        raise RuntimeError(f"{label} unlock timed out after {timeout:.0f}s") from exc
    87	    except OSError as exc:
    88	        raise RuntimeError(f"failed to invoke {label}: {exc}") from exc
    89	
    90	
    91	def _cfg() -> Dict:
    92	    from hermes_cli.config import load_config_readonly
    93	    cfg = load_config_readonly().get("vault") or {}
    94	    return cfg if isinstance(cfg, dict) else {}
    95	
    96	
    97	def external_backend_classes():
    98	    from agent.vault_backends.bitwarden import BitwardenLoginBackend
    99	    from agent.vault_backends.onepassword import OnePasswordLoginBackend
   100	    return (OnePasswordLoginBackend, BitwardenLoginBackend)
   101	
   102	
   103	def is_installed(name: str) -> bool:
   104	    """Is the manager CLI reachable — honouring a configured ``binary_path`` over PATH."""
   105	    import shutil
   106	    section = _cfg().get(name) or {}
   107	    explicit = str(section.get("binary_path") or "") if isinstance(section, dict) else ""
   108	    if explicit:
   109	        return Path(explicit).is_file()
   110	    if name == "onepassword":
   111	        from agent.secret_sources.onepassword import find_op
   112	        return find_op() is not None
   113	    return shutil.which("bw") is not None
   114	
   115	
   116	def is_enabled(name: str) -> bool:
   117	    """An installed manager is a login source unless the user opted out (``vault.<name>.enabled: false``).
   118	    Zero-config on purpose: a user with ``bw``/``op`` on PATH should never have to discover a toggle."""
   119	    section = _cfg().get(name) or {}
   120	    if isinstance(section, dict) and section.get("enabled") is False:
   121	        return False
   122	    return is_installed(name)
   123	
   124	
   125	def enabled_backends() -> List[LoginBackend]:
   126	    """Local first (always on), then every detected external manager the user has not turned off."""
   127	    from agent.vault_backends.local import LocalLoginBackend
   128	
   129	    cfg = _cfg()
   130	    out: List[LoginBackend] = [LocalLoginBackend()]
   131	    for cls in external_backend_classes():
   132	        if is_enabled(cls.name):
   133	            section = cfg.get(cls.name) or {}
   134	            out.append(cls(section if isinstance(section, dict) else {}))
   135	    return out

     5	from __future__ import annotations
     6	
     7	import os
     8	from typing import Callable, Optional
     9	
    10	from agent.browser_provider import BrowserProvider as CloudBrowserProvider
    11	from agent.browser_registry import get_provider as _registry_get_browser_provider
    12	from hermes_constants import get_hermes_home_override, hermes_home_key
    13	from plugins.browser.browser_use.provider import BrowserUseBrowserProvider
    14	from plugins.browser.browserbase.provider import BrowserbaseBrowserProvider
    15	from tools.tool_backend_helpers import normalize_browser_cloud_provider

    17	from tools.browser_tool_origin import origin_module as _origin
    18	from tools import browser_tool_cdp as _cdp

    21	def _memo(_bt, resolved_attr: str, cache_attr: str, compute: Callable[[], object]):
    22	    """Process-lifetime cache on ``_bt``: the resolved flag is set BEFORE computing, then the final value is stored.
    23	
    24	    Under a routed profile (HERMES_HOME override, multiplexed gateway) the slot is NOT consulted: every
    25	    ``_memo`` here caches a ``browser.*`` config read, and one process-wide slot would hand the launch
    26	    profile's engine/headed/private-URL policy to every other profile (same rule as ``_allow_private_urls``).
    27	    """
    28	    if get_hermes_home_override() is not None:
    29	        return compute()
    30	    if not getattr(_bt, resolved_attr):
    31	        setattr(_bt, resolved_attr, True)
    32	        setattr(_bt, cache_attr, compute())
    33	    return getattr(_bt, cache_attr)
    34	
    35	
    36	def _ensure_browser_plugins_loaded() -> None:
    37	    """Idempotently trigger plugin discovery (standalone scripts/tests may never import ``model_tools``)."""
    38	    try:
    39	        from hermes_cli.plugins import _ensure_plugins_discovered
    40	        _ensure_plugins_discovered()
    41	    except Exception as exc:
    42	        _origin().logger.debug("Browser plugin discovery failed (non-fatal): %s", exc)
    43	
    44	
    45	def _get_cloud_provider() -> Optional[CloudBrowserProvider]:
    46	    """Return the provider cached for the active Hermes profile."""
    47	    _bt = _origin()
    48	    scope = hermes_home_key()
    49	    with _bt._cloud_provider_cache_lock:
    50	        # A cleared boolean (tests / legacy reset) is a full reset even if a scoped resolution is still mirrored here.
    51	        if not _bt._cloud_provider_resolved:
    52	            _bt._cached_cloud_provider_scope = None
    53	            _bt._cached_cloud_providers.clear()
    54	        while True:
    55	            before_generation = _bt._browser_registry_generation(scope=scope)
    56	            cache_key = (scope, before_generation)
    57	            if cache_key in _bt._cached_cloud_providers:
    58	                _bt._cached_cloud_provider = _bt._cached_cloud_providers[cache_key]
    59	                _bt._cloud_provider_resolved = True
    60	                _bt._cached_cloud_provider_scope = scope
    61	                return _bt._cached_cloud_provider
    62	            _bt._cached_cloud_provider = None
    63	            _bt._cloud_provider_resolved = False
    64	            resolved = _resolve_cloud_provider_uncached()
    65	            after_generation = _bt._browser_registry_generation(scope=scope)
    66	            if before_generation != after_generation:  # force reload mid-resolution: discard, resolve again
    67	                continue
    68	            if _bt._cloud_provider_resolved:
    69	                _bt._cached_cloud_provider_scope = scope
    70	                for stale_key in [key for key in _bt._cached_cloud_providers if key[0] == scope]:
    71	                    _bt._cached_cloud_providers.pop(stale_key, None)
    72	                _bt._cached_cloud_providers[cache_key] = resolved
    73	            return resolved

    76	def _instantiate_explicit_cloud_provider(provider_key: str) -> Optional[CloudBrowserProvider]:
    77	    """Build the provider named by ``browser.cloud_provider``.
    78	
    79	    Strict: an unregistered name raises ``ValueError`` (never a silent reroute to auto-detect); any
    80	    other instantiation error is logged and yields None so the next call retries.
    81	    """
    82	    _bt = _origin()
    83	    try:
    84	        _ensure_browser_plugins_loaded()
    85	        resolved = _registry_get_browser_provider(provider_key)
    86	        if resolved is None:
    87	            from tools.tool_backend_helpers import selection_error
    88	            raise ValueError(selection_error(
    89	                "browser", f"'{provider_key}'",
    90	                "no registered browser plugin has that name (install the corresponding plugin or fix the config key spelling)",
    91	            ))
    92	        return resolved
    93	    except ValueError:
    94	        raise
    95	    except Exception:
    96	        _bt.logger.warning("Failed to instantiate explicit cloud_provider %r; will retry on next call", provider_key, exc_info=True)
    97	        return None

   100	def _autodetect_cloud_provider() -> Optional[CloudBrowserProvider]:
   101	    """Auto-detect: Browser Use, then Browserbase; never raises.
   102	
   103	    Third-party plugins are only reachable via explicit ``browser.cloud_provider: <name>``.
   104	    """
   105	    _bt = _origin()
   106	    try:
   107	        for cls in (BrowserUseBrowserProvider, BrowserbaseBrowserProvider):
   108	            fallback_provider = cls()
   109	            if fallback_provider.is_available():
   110	                return fallback_provider
   111	    except Exception:  # pragma: no cover - defensive: never poison cache
   112	        _bt.logger.debug("Cloud provider auto-detect failed", exc_info=True)
   113	    return None
   114	
   115	
   116	def _resolve_cloud_provider_uncached() -> Optional[CloudBrowserProvider]:
   117	    """Return the configured cloud browser provider, or None for local mode.
   118	
   119	    Pins the cache only when definitive (explicit ``local``/``camofox`` or a resolved provider); a transient None
   120	    (unreadable config, missing credentials) is NOT cached so it can self-heal. Auto-detect runs only when no
   121	    selection was ever written.
   122	    """
   123	    _bt = _origin()
   124	    resolved: Optional[CloudBrowserProvider] = None
   125	    provider_key = None
   126	    try:
   127	        from hermes_cli.config import read_raw_config
   128	        browser_cfg = read_raw_config().get("browser", {})
   129	        if isinstance(browser_cfg, dict) and "cloud_provider" in browser_cfg:
   130	            provider_key = normalize_browser_cloud_provider(browser_cfg.get("cloud_provider"))
   131	            if provider_key in ("local", "camofox"):
   132	                # Camofox runs through the built-in browser tools, not a cloud provider.
   133	                _bt._cached_cloud_provider = None
   134	                _bt._cloud_provider_resolved = True
   135	                return None
   136	            if provider_key == "nous":
   137	                # Managed "Nous Subscription" is serviced by the Browser Use provider.
   138	                provider_key = "browser-use"
   139	        if provider_key:
   140	            resolved = _instantiate_explicit_cloud_provider(provider_key)
   141	            if resolved is None:
   142	                return None
   143	    except ValueError:
   144	        raise
   145	    except Exception as e:
   146	        # Config may be temporarily unreadable; still try auto-detect (env/managed creds). Don't pin cache.
   147	        _bt.logger.debug("Could not read cloud_provider from config: %s", e)
   148	
   149	    if resolved is None and provider_key is None:
   150	        resolved = _autodetect_cloud_provider()
   151	    if resolved is None:
   152	        return None
   153	    _bt._cached_cloud_provider = resolved
   154	    _bt._cloud_provider_resolved = True
   155	    return _bt._cached_cloud_provider
   156	
   157	
   158	def _is_local_mode() -> bool:
   159	    """Return True when the browser tool will use a local browser backend."""
   160	    _bt = _origin()
   161	    return not _cdp._get_cdp_override_raw() and _get_cloud_provider() is None
   162	
   163	
   164	def _is_local_backend() -> bool:
   165	    """True when the browser runs locally AND the terminal is also local.
   166	
   167	    SSRF protection only matters when the browser can reach networks the terminal cannot (cloud backends,
   168	    containerized terminals). A CDP override is never trusted as local (that Chrome may live off-host) and MUST
   169	    be checked before the Camofox short-circuit; ``_is_local_mode`` treats overrides the same way — keep the two
   170	    in agreement.
   171	    """
   172	    _bt = _origin()
   173	    if _cdp._get_cdp_override_raw():
   174	        return False
   175	    if _bt._is_camofox_mode():
   176	        return True
   177	    if _get_cloud_provider() is not None:
   178	        return False
   179	    # Scope-aware: under gateway multiplexing the routed profile's terminal backend lives in the per-turn scope.
   180	    # When terminal runs in a container, browser on host can access internal networks the terminal can't →
   181	    # treat as non-local. See #68559.
   182	    from tools.terminal_scope import terminal_env
   183	    return terminal_env("TERMINAL_ENV", "local").strip().lower() in ("local", "")
   184	
   185	
   186	def _get_browser_engine() -> str:
   187	    """Return the browser engine: ``auto`` (no ``--engine`` flag), ``lightpanda`` or ``chrome``.
   188	
   189	    ``browser.engine`` first, then ``AGENT_BROWSER_ENGINE``, then ``auto``; cached. Lightpanda is faster on
   190	    navigation but has no graphical renderer (no screenshots).
   191	    """
   192	    _bt = _origin()
   193	    def compute() -> str:
   194	        engine = _bt._browser_cfg("engine", "auto", lambda v: str(v).strip().lower() if v and str(v).strip() else "auto", "browser.engine from config")
   195	        if engine == "auto":
   196	            engine = os.environ.get("AGENT_BROWSER_ENGINE", "").strip().lower() or engine
   197	        # agent-browser only accepts "chrome" and "lightpanda".
   198	        _VALID_ENGINES = {"auto", "lightpanda", "chrome"}
   199	        if engine not in _VALID_ENGINES:
   200	            _bt.logger.warning("Unknown browser engine %r (valid: %s), falling back to 'auto'", engine, ", ".join(sorted(_VALID_ENGINES)))
   201	            engine = "auto"
   202	        return engine
   203	    return _memo(_bt, "_browser_engine_resolved", "_cached_browser_engine", compute)
   204	
   205	
   206	def _is_headed_mode() -> bool:
   207	    """True when the browser should launch headed: ``browser.headed``, else ``AGENT_BROWSER_HEADED``; cached."""
   208	    _bt = _origin()
   209	    def compute() -> bool:
   210	        headed = _bt._browser_cfg("headed", False, lambda v: False if v is None else str(v).strip().lower() in ("true", "1", "yes"), "browser.headed from config")
   211	        return headed or os.environ.get("AGENT_BROWSER_HEADED", "").strip().lower() in ("true", "1", "yes")
   212	    return _memo(_bt, "_headed_mode_resolved", "_cached_headed_mode", compute)
   213	
   214	
   215	def _should_inject_engine(engine: str) -> bool:
   216	    """True when ``--engine`` should be added: explicit (non-``auto``) engine on a non-cloud, non-camofox local session."""
   217	    _bt = _origin()
   218	    return engine != "auto" and not _bt._is_camofox_mode() and _is_local_mode()

   211	    """Rewrite loopback page URLs for Docker-hosted Camofox, if configured.
   212

   214	    the browser *inside* the container, where loopback is the container, not the host.

20	
    21	In all modes, the agent can navigate websites, interact with page elements, fill forms, and extract information.
    22	
    23	## Overview
    24	
    25	Pages are represented as **accessibility trees** (text-based snapshots), making them ideal for LLM agents. Interactive elements get ref IDs (like `@e1`, `@e2`) that the agent uses for clicking and typing.
    26	
    27	Key capabilities:
    28	
    29	- **Multi-provider cloud execution** — Browser Use, Browserbase, or Firecrawl — no local browser needed
    30	- **Local Chromium-family integration** — attach to your running Chrome, Brave, Chromium, or Edge browser via CDP for hands-on browsing
    31	- **Cloud anti-bot support** — Browser Use Cloud includes stealth, residential proxies, and CAPTCHA solving
    32	- **Persistent cloud profiles** — Browser Use Cloud can reuse cookies, localStorage, and saved passwords across sessions
    33	- **Session isolation** — each task gets its own browser session
    34	- **Automatic cleanup** — inactive sessions are closed after a timeout
    35	- **Vision analysis** — screenshot + AI analysis for visual understanding
    36	
    37	## Setup
    38	
    39	:::tip Nous Subscribers
    40	If you have a paid [Nous Portal](https://portal.nousresearch.com) subscription, you can use browser automation through the **[Tool Gateway](tool-gateway.md)** without any separate API keys. New installs can run `hermes setup --portal` to log in and turn on every gateway tool at once; existing installs can pick **Nous Subscription** as the browser provider via `hermes model` or `hermes tools`.
    41	:::
    42	
    43	### Browser Use cloud mode
    44	
    45	To use Browser Use as your cloud browser provider, add:
    46	
    47	```bash
    48	# Add to ~/.hermes/.env
    49	BROWSER_USE_API_KEY=***
    50	```
    51	
    52	Get your API key at [browser-use.com](https://browser-use.com).
    53	
    54	Browser Use Cloud runs managed Chromium with [stealth](https://docs.browser-use.com/cloud/browser/stealth) and [residential proxies](https://docs.browser-use.com/cloud/browser/proxies) enabled by default, includes CAPTCHA solving, and supports [persistent profiles](https://docs.browser-use.com/cloud/guides/authentication) for cookies, localStorage, and saved passwords.
    55	
    56	### Browserbase cloud mode
    57	
    58	To use Browserbase-managed cloud browsers, add:
    59	
    60	```bash
    61	# Add to ~/.hermes/.env
    62	BROWSERBASE_API_KEY=***
    63	REDACTED
    64	```
    65	
    66	Get your credentials at [browserbase.com](https://browserbase.com).
    67	
    68	:::note Selecting the provider
    69	The `.env` keys above supply **credentials only**. The active cloud browser is chosen by the `browser.cloud_provider` selection written by `hermes tools` → Browser Automation (`browserbase`, `browser-use`, `camofox`, or `nous` for the Nous Subscription). Once a selection exists, adding or removing a key does not switch providers — and a selected provider with a missing key errors with guidance to run `hermes tools` instead of silently rerouting. Never-configured setups still autodetect from available credentials.
    70	:::
    71	
    72	### Browser Use mode (default)
    73	
    74	Browser Use mode uses the [Browser Use CLI 3.0](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use) instead of the built-in browser tools. The agent writes and executes Python in the browser to click, type, drag, scrape, and interact with webpages.
    75	
    76	**This is the default browser mode**: when `browser.backend` is unset and the `browser-use` CLI is runnable (installed, or available through `uvx`), the agent gets the single `browser_exec` tool. If the CLI can't run, Hermes falls back to the built-in browser tools automatically.
    77	
    78	The mode is a **driver** that composes with your configured browser backend: it drives Hermes' own headless Chromium, a Nous-subscription cloud browser, Browserbase, Firecrawl, or Browser Use cloud browsers — whichever browser source is selected in `hermes tools` → Browser Automation. The one exception is Camofox, which has no CDP endpoint for the harness to attach to; Camofox setups automatically keep the built-in browser tools.
    79

    21	In all modes, the agent can navigate websites, interact with page elements, fill forms, and extract information.
    22	
    23	## Overview
    24	
    25	Pages are represented as **accessibility trees** (text-based snapshots), making them ideal for LLM agents. Interactive elements get ref IDs (like `@e1`, `@e2`) that the agent uses for clicking and typing.
    26	
    27	Key capabilities:
    28	
    29	- **Multi-provider cloud execution** — Browser Use, Browserbase, or Firecrawl — no local browser needed
    30	- **Local Chromium-family integration** — attach to your running Chrome, Brave, Chromium, or Edge browser via CDP for hands-on browsing
    31	- **Cloud anti-bot support** — Browser Use Cloud includes stealth, residential proxies, and CAPTCHA solving
    32	- **Persistent cloud profiles** — Browser Use Cloud can reuse cookies, localStorage, and saved passwords across sessions
    33	- **Session isolation** — each task gets its own browser session
    34	- **Automatic cleanup** — inactive sessions are closed after a timeout
